purpose: Make wartime rewind segments explicit and distinguish archival branches from execution-valid restart nodes.

requirements: regenerate 1942-05-04..05-06 information-state handout with restored COMINT

nodes.note: 5/7 Coral Sea combat not executed; mandatory 5/4-6 re-audit fields must close before event resolution.

invalidation_classes.EVIDENCE_POINTER_ONLY: no rerun if runtime value/status unchanged
invalidation_classes.TECH_ENTRY_VALUE_CHANGE: find checkpoints/events whose handouts include changed tech entry or dependent intermediate state; revalidate/rerun descendants from earliest affected event
invalidation_classes.PREWAR_REALIZATION_CHANGE: new WARSTART baseline; all wartime descendants require impact review
invalidation_classes.WARSTART_STATE_CHANGE: new WARSTART baseline; all descendants require impact review
invalidation_classes.CHECKPOINT_STATE_CHANGE: invalidate descendants of that checkpoint only
invalidation_classes.RULE_RUNTIME_CHANGE: use rule dependency mapping; rerun from earliest event whose calculation used affected rule

principle: Archived branches are never deleted. Execution validity is a separate property. Current restart authority is the formal 1942-05-06T24 node, not archived MO/MI branches.
